## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Vatican City, Vatican. It starts at 203,Corso Vittorio Emanuele II.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Rome is built on 3,000 years of stories. _Welcome to Rome_ is an immersive multimedia exhibit that grounds you in the city’s historical and architectural legacy. A visit here will help you get the most out of your Roman holiday.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €20.78. It was rated 4.6 out of 5 from 202 ratings and 112 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
